description: The line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters, varying the parameter r, using the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis, labeled "log r," spans from 0 to 9, indicating the logarithmic scale of the parameter r. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1," ranges from 0 to 35, representing the ROUGE-1 metric scores. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different model and adapter combination: T5 + LoRA (red), MBart + LoRA (purple), T5 + AdaLoRA (green), and MBart + AdaLoRA (orange). The T5 + LoRA line remains relatively flat, starting at a score of around 24 and ending slightly above this value. The MBart + LoRA line shows a significant increase, starting at a score of around 5 and peaking at 34 before slightly declining. The T5 + AdaLoRA line exhibits a steady increase, starting at around 24 and reaching a score of about 30. The MBart + AdaLoRA line also shows a steady increase, starting at around 5 and reaching a score of about 34.
